title: soap dish, self draining
text: soap dish, self draining. These are very sturdy and tilt forward to assist in the draining process. I use them under my handsoap and dishsoap bottles - which are pump action.  There is always water around the bottles and I wanted something to drain the water away... so far.. these are working.  The rounder bottom of the dishsoap is a little tricky - but so far it's working.  The handsoap bottle is a little oval, like the shape of the dish, so it works better.  The tilt forward is a little tricky as the bottle naturally tilts forward too.  I'm testing it out - but as I said, it's working fairly well.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
